settings.question: How do I choose between Slim, Regular, and Oversized fits?
settings.answer: Regular is our signature tailored block with clean chest room. Slim tapers 3 cm closer through the waist for wearing under suiting. Oversized features a dropped shoulder and relaxed drape—take your normal size in each block.

settings.question: Will Gridium cotton or linen shirts shrink after washing?
settings.answer: All fabrics undergo mill sanforization and garment pre-washing. When washed cold (30°C) and hung dry, dimensional variance remains under 1.5%.

settings.question: How fast do orders ship and can I exchange sizes?
settings.answer: In-stock orders placed before 2 PM EST dispatch the same business day. Size exchanges and returns are complimentary within 30 days of delivery.

settings.question: Are your heavyweight T-shirts see-through in white?
settings.answer: Never. Our Optic White tee is knitted at a dense 240 GSM from two-ply combed Supima cotton specifically to guarantee full opacity and collar retention.
